title: Small dhikr, consistent - beats large irregular
translation: 100 istighfar in morning traffic. 33 tasbih after salah, no rush. Hasbunallah 7x. These small consistent become anchor.
lesson: We wait for perfect khushu, perfect time. But Allah loves small consistent deeds. Start with 2 minutes, not 2 hours.
reflection: Key: attach dhikr to existing habit. After wudu: ayatul kursi. In car: istighfar. Before sleep: my Lord forgive parents.
